description.value: Falcon Resort is a lakefront motel in Osoyoos, BC, situated directly on over 300 feet of private sandy beach on Osoyoos Lake — Canada's warmest lake. Units range from single rooms to two-bedroom suites with kitchens, and the property features two outdoor heated pools and an indoor spa. It operates alongside the adjacent Spanish Fiesta Resort under shared management, together forming a well-established family-friendly beach destination in the South Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for falcon-spanish.com confirms this is the Falcon Resort at 7106 Main Street, Osoyoos, BC V0H 1V3, with phone (250) 495-7544, matching the OSM tags exactly. The General Information section on /reviews.html provides an explicit amenity list including 'Laundry Room' and 'Wireless Internet', and mentions 'Restaurants Within Walking Distance'; no mention of bike storage, bike-specific services, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site. The 'Air pump for floating devices' noted on the site refers to beach inflatables, not a bike pump.
concerns: Website copyright reads '© 2011' — the site appears old and minimally maintained, though contact details and content remain consistent and no closure indicators are present.

OSM name is 'Falcon Resort' but the website brands both properties jointly as 'Spanish Fiesta & Falcon Resorts'; the OSM record correctly targets the Falcon Resort half of the complex at 7106 Main Street.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational beachfront motel in Osoyoos with confirmed contact details and an active website; useful stopover for touring cyclists in the South Okanagan.
